eras.name: Midnight Mercenarys
eras.summary: Hello, and welcome the the Midnight Mercenaries steam group. We're a group consisting of gamers, artists, coders and much more. We currently own 2 Divisions right now. We have a Division in Mount & Musket, a modification for Mount & Blade: Warband. We also have a division in Battlegrounds 2, A modification for Half-Life 2. If you're interested in joining go to www.midnightmercs.enjin.com!Midnight Mercenaries Website[www.midnightmercs.enjin.com]2nd Coldstream Regiment of Footguards (Napoleonic Wars Division)
eras.note: The first Midnight Mercs group — the community proper, rather than a single regiment.

eras.name: Midnight Mercenaries Multi-Gaming Community
eras.summary: The Midnight Mercs Gaming Community aims for simple enjoyment of whatever game that's is being played, without all of the drama that's included in most clans. Our main goals are not only to provide a fun and enjoyable gaming atmosphere for guests / veterans alike, but to filter anything that could possibly ruin a gaming experience. If you're having troubles within the community it's guaranteed that if you tell an admin, it'll be solved as soon as possible. Interested in joining? Head over to our website below.Midnight Mercenaries Website[www.midnightmercs.enjin.com]
eras.note: Midnight Mercs relaunched as an explicitly multi-gaming community, running alongside the regiment.

eras.name: Nox Viator Gaming
eras.headline: Sed domi maneas paresque nobis novem continuas fututiones
eras.summary: Nox Viator is a PC Gaming Community founded June 28, 2011. Over the years we've built a core group of friendly and helpful gamers with the goal of providing an enjoyable gaming atmosphere for guests and veterans alike. If you're having troubles within the community it's guaranteed that if you tell an Admin, it'll be solved as soon as possible. If you're interested in joining, click the link below or add RiveR on steam!Nox Viator Website[www.noxviator.enjin.com]
eras.note: The community hub through the middle years. Ran almost no events itself — it was the home, not the unit — and rebranded to RoaR Gaming in October 2017.

eras.name: RoaR Gaming Community
eras.summary: RoaR.GG is a PC Gaming Community founded December, 2011. We believe games are more enjoyable in a organized environment but without all of the bull**** that's included in most gaming communities. RoaR.GG was initially founded as a Mount & Blade: Warband group but in 2017 we decided to make a big change and rebrand to an esports community. Due to the hard work and ambition of our staff and members through the transition we've been successful in growing our brand, providing teams, servers and events for our newly founded esports community. To many of us RoaR.GG is much more than a gaming community, it's a family. Looking to join? Add River, Kavcav or Maximus on steam.http://roaresports.com
eras.note: RoaR Gaming — the 2017 rebrand out of Nox Viator, and the era that carried the community through the late 2010s.
